Why Al Rahal

The dealer's tools. A specialist's attention. A neighbour's prices.

Dealer-level diagnostics

We run Land Rover's own Pathfinder and SDD platforms, so software updates, coding and guided tests are done exactly as the factory intends.

Rebuilt in-house

Engines, gearboxes, air suspension and transfer cases are rebuilt on our own benches, not sent away. Faster, cheaper and fully accountable.

Genuine parts, written warranty

Genuine Land Rover parts by default, high-quality OE alternatives where they make sense, and a warranty term printed on every invoice.

Everything on WhatsApp

Booking, diagnostic reports, photos of worn parts and approval for every item of work. You are never surprised by the invoice.

Same-day for common jobs

Air struts, brakes, batteries, servicing and diagnostics are usually completed the same day. Collection and delivery available.

Trained on Land Rover

Our senior technicians are former main-dealer master technicians. They chose to specialise because they love these cars.

How it works

Four steps from message to handover.

Message us

Send your model, year and symptoms on WhatsApp. We reply within minutes with an initial view and a booking time.

Diagnose properly

Your car goes on the lift and the diagnostic platform. You receive a written report with photos and a fixed price.

Approve each item

Nothing is done without your approval. We show you the worn parts and explain what can wait.

Collect with confidence

Road tested, cleaned, service record updated and warranty documented. Or we deliver it to your door.

Good to know

Frequently asked questions

Do you only work on Range Rover and Land Rover?

Range Rover and Land Rover are our speciality and the majority of our work, but we also service BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Audi, Porsche, Jaguar, Bentley and Rolls-Royce with the correct diagnostic equipment for each brand.

Will servicing at Al Rahal affect my manufacturer warranty?

No. We use genuine parts, follow the manufacturer's schedule and update your online service record, which keeps your warranty valid.

How do I book?

Tap any WhatsApp button on this site, or message 055 747 9292 with your model, year and the issue. We reply within minutes during working hours and confirm a time.

Do you offer pick-up and delivery?

Yes, we offer vehicle collection and return within the city. Ask on WhatsApp when booking.

Do you provide a warranty on repairs?

All repairs carry a parts and labour warranty. The term is stated on your invoice before work begins.
